The Lore

THEY WERE NEVER FULLY MECHANICAL

They found the first one buried under old server farms, half melted into the concrete. No serial number. No manufacturer. Just a date stamped into the metal decades before ARC ever existed. Engineers who studied it stopped sleeping well. The eyes weren't cameras. They were watching.

By the time the second one surfaced, the pattern was clear: these weren't machines built for a purpose. They were built to wait. Some still wore their original plating, cold, precise, untouched by time. Others had been stripped down to something worse. Bone. Flame. As if whatever built them wanted you to remember they were never fully mechanical to begin with.

2,222 have been recovered so far. No two alike. No blueprint on record. The last engineer to examine one left a single note before she disconnected the lab's power grid for good: they are not activating. They are choosing.

ARCTITAN: 2222 genesis recovered. Each one different. Hand drawn. None of them finished waking up.
